Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made the critical mistake in step 6 by failing to identify the conflicting information on the Wikipedia page regarding Benito Perojo's birthplace (both "Buenos Aires, Argentina" in the body text and "Madrid, Spain" in the infobox). Instead of highlighting the discrepancy and seeking further clarification from authoritative sources, WebSurfer prematurely relied on IMDb as the sole source to conclude that Madrid was the birthplace. This lack of deeper investigation and failure to address conflicting information led to an unreliable final answer.
